stories.title: Eleven objections to Mold Road convenience store alcohol licence in Cefn-y-bedd
stories.summary: Plans for a convenience store in Cefn-y-bedd to sell alcohol from 6am to 10pm, seven days a week, have drawn 11 objections from people living nearby. stories.title: New CPS rules let police charge shoplifters whatever the value of the goods or the plea
stories.summary: Police can now charge shoplifters themselves, whatever the value of the goods and whether or not the suspect admits it, under new rules in force from today. In Flintshire, recorded shoplifting rose by 16% in the year to March 2026, even as it fell across Wales and England, Office for National Statistics (ONS) figures show.

stories.title: Coffee King seeks suppliers for roasters and bakery ovens at Deeside Industrial Park site
stories.summary: The family-owned firm wants three industrial coffee roasters, packaging lines and bakery equipment, with bids due in by noon on Friday.

stories.title: Rolex watch and designer bags among police seized goods going to auction in Ewloe
stories.summary: A Rolex watch, designer handbags and two off-road motorbikes are among the items going under the hammer at a police auction in Ewloe later this month. stories.title: Discoloured water affects homes in parts of Deeside as repair gets under way
stories.summary: Homes in parts of Deeside are being affected by discoloured water, with Welsh Water saying it expects supplies to be clear by later this evening.
